description: tiktok: Comments. GET /v1/tiktok/video/comments. Get comments on public TikTok videos or slideshows. Pages with comments cost 1 credit; empty pages cost 0. An empty page does not prove the post has no comments globally. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Costs 0 credits when comments is empty. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.
